summary: Deutsche Bank AG filed a Form 6-K furnishing a legal opinion and consents from Fried, Frank, Harris, Shriver & Jacobson LLP regarding its shelf registration on Form F-3 for Senior Notes Series A, Senior Debt Funding Notes Series E, and Eligible Liabilities Senior Notes Series D. No securities are priced or sold, no stake, price per share, premium, or deal date is stated. The filing is a routine debt-shelf documentation update incorporated by reference into Registration Statement No. 333-278331. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor engagement, or risk-arb angle exists; no watch items beyond ordinary future takedowns.
